faq.title: WorthTrail FAQ & Product Facts — No-Bank-Login Net Worth Tracker
faq.meta_description: Answers to common questions about WorthTrail: privacy without bank login, multi-currency assets, pricing and lifetime purchase, dividends, FIRE, data sources, and Mac MCP.
faq.lead: Straightforward answers about WorthTrail’s privacy model, asset coverage, pricing, and Mac MCP server.

items.q: Does WorthTrail require connecting a bank or brokerage account?
items.a_plain: No. WorthTrail never asks for bank or brokerage credentials and does not integrate with Plaid or third-party account aggregators. You record your holdings and balances directly, while public market prices and exchange rates refresh automatically.
items.a_html: No. WorthTrail is intentionally built without bank login or Plaid. You record your positions, cash, deposits, and liabilities directly, while public market quotes and foreign exchange rates update automatically.

items.q: Where is my portfolio data stored?
items.a_plain: All data is stored locally on your device using Apple SwiftData. If you turn on iCloud sync, your data syncs exclusively through your personal Apple CloudKit private database. WorthTrail does not operate a server that stores or reads your portfolio.
items.a_html: Your data is stored locally on your device using Apple SwiftData. Optional multi-device sync uses your personal Apple iCloud (CloudKit) private database. The developer does not run a server that collects or sees your portfolio, and the app contains no ads or third-party analytics SDKs.

items.q: How does pricing work? Is there a one-time purchase?
items.a_plain: Yes. Every feature in WorthTrail is free for up to 10 items (assets, cash accounts, and liabilities combined). WorthTrail Pro unlocks unlimited assets only and is available as $0.99/month, $5.99/year, or a $12.99 one-time Lifetime purchase in the US.
items.a_html: Yes. The free tier includes all features for up to 10 items (assets, cash accounts, and liabilities combined). WorthTrail Pro removes the 10-item cap only: US$0.99/month, US$5.99/year, or US$12.99 one-time Lifetime (equalized across 175 App Store storefronts, e.g., ¥8/month, ¥38/year, ¥88 Lifetime in mainland China).

items.q: What asset types and markets are supported?
items.a_plain: WorthTrail tracks stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, cryptocurrencies, options, fixed-term deposits (CDs, GICs, term deposits), bank wealth products, cash, custom assets such as property or gold, and liabilities such as mortgages and loans. Multi-currency holdings convert automatically into your base currency.
items.a_html: WorthTrail tracks global stocks (US, HK, CN A-shares, TW, and international exchanges), ETFs, mutual funds, cryptocurrencies, options, fixed-term deposits (CDs, GICs, term deposits), supported bank wealth products, cash, custom manually valued assets (real estate, gold, private equity, bonds), and liabilities (mortgages, loans, credit cards). All currencies convert into your chosen base currency.

items.q: Which market data providers does WorthTrail use?
items.a_plain: You can enable, disable, and reorder data sources in Settings > Data Sources & Status, including Yahoo Finance, Webull, Binance, OKX, Sina Finance, TWSE, ExchangeRate-API, and supported bank wealth product feeds.
items.a_html: You can enable, disable, and reorder data sources in Settings > Data Sources & Status, including Yahoo Finance, Webull, Binance, OKX, Sina Finance, TWSE, ExchangeRate-API, and supported bank wealth product feeds. Only the necessary symbol and currency queries are sent to the providers you enable.

items.q: Does WorthTrail support dividends, FIRE, and rebalancing?
items.a_plain: Yes. WorthTrail includes a dividend calendar with ex-date booking and tax-adjusted passive income, dividend growth and concentration views, a FIRE planner, recurring investment plans, stock split adjustments, and a target allocation rebalancing calculator.
items.a_html: Yes. WorthTrail includes a dividend calendar with ex-date booking and tax-adjusted passive income, dividend growth and concentration analytics, a customizable FIRE dashboard (target, passive income coverage, projected date, and plan-to-age sustainability), recurring investment (DCA) plans, stock split adjustments, and a target allocation rebalancing calculator.

items.q: How does the Mac local MCP server work?
items.a_plain: On Mac, WorthTrail includes an optional local Streamable HTTP MCP server at http://127.0.0.1:47821/mcp secured with a Keychain Bearer token for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Codex. Write actions are disabled by default and require two-step preview confirmation.
items.a_html: On Mac, WorthTrail includes an optional local Streamable HTTP MCP server (http://127.0.0.1:47821/mcp) secured with a Keychain Bearer token. You can connect Claude Code, Claude Desktop, or Codex to query net worth, holdings, returns, dividends, and FIRE metrics. Write actions are disabled by default and always require a two-step preview and confirmation code. See the Mac MCP guide.

items.a_html: Yes. You can export password-encrypted local backups (and restore them anytime), as well as Excel (.xlsx) workbooks and PDF reports for archiving or external analysis.

vs.title: WorthTrail vs Monarch Money, Copilot Money, Kubera & Spreadsheets
vs.meta_description: An objective comparison of WorthTrail against Monarch Money, Copilot Money, Kubera, and spreadsheets—covering bank login requirements, privacy, multi-currency assets, pricing, and Mac MCP.
vs.h1: WorthTrail vs Popular Net Worth Trackers
vs.lead_html: Different net worth tools solve different problems. Below is a straightforward comparison of WorthTrail against Monarch Money, Copilot Money, Kubera, and spreadsheets—including when you should choose another tool instead.
vs.table_note: Note: Third-party pricing and features are approximate and may change; check each vendor’s official website for current details.

bullets_html: Choose Monarch Money if you live in the US or Canada, want automatic bank and credit card transaction syncing, household cash-flow budgeting, and web/Android access.

Choose WorthTrail if you refuse to connect bank credentials, invest across multiple currencies or non-US markets (e.g., HK, CN, TW, UK, AU, EU), prefer local-first iCloud storage, and want a $12.99 one-time lifetime option instead of a ~$100/year subscription.
Choose Copilot Money if you want an Apple-focused daily budgeting and expense-tracking app powered by automatic US bank and credit card feeds.

Choose WorthTrail if your focus is net worth, investment returns, dividends, fixed-term deposits, rebalancing, and FIRE rather than daily expense categorization—and you want zero bank logins, multi-currency support, and a Mac MCP server.
Choose Kubera if you want a web-based global wealth tracker with automated brokerage/bank aggregation and estate beneficiary features, and you are comfortable with an annual cloud subscription.

Choose WorthTrail if you prefer a native iPhone/iPad/Mac app where your portfolio never touches a vendor server, with automatic market quotes, P&L calendar, dividend calendar, FIRE planning, and a fraction of the cost ($5.99/yr or $12.99 lifetime).
Choose Spreadsheets if you need completely bespoke financial models or custom formulas on Windows/Linux/Web.

Choose WorthTrail if you are tired of broken quote formulas, manual FX updates, and maintaining historical net-worth snapshots by hand—while still being able to export clean Excel (.xlsx) workbooks anytime.

vs.cta_lead: Start free with all features unlocked for up to 10 items—no account sign-up and no bank login required.

mcp.connect_intro_html: Open WorthTrail on Mac → Settings → Agent Access, turn on local agent access, and copy your personal setup prompt or Bearer token.
mcp.tools_h2: What AI Agents Can Query & Do
mcp.read_h3: Read Tools (Enabled when Agent Access is on)
read_items_html: Current net worth, total assets, liabilities, cost basis, and daily change (get_net_worth)
Open positions by category or currency, including stocks, ETFs, crypto, options, deposits, and custom assets (list_positions, list_liabilities)
Historical snapshots and daily holding breakdowns (get_snapshots, get_snapshot_detail)
Period investment performance, money-weighted return curves, and daily earnings by holding (get_performance, get_daily_earnings)
Dividends, recurring plans, transaction history, and FIRE projections
write_items_html: Disabled by default—enabling read access never enables writes automatically.

Two-step confirmation: The first tool call returns a human-readable preview and a short-lived confirmation code. The change is applied only when you approve the preview and the agent submits the second call with that code.
Supports recording trades, position adjustments, assets, liabilities, plans, and undo actions—with a built-in change log in Settings.
example_questions: “What is my current net worth in USD, and how much did my portfolio change this month?”
“Which holdings contributed the most to my P&L over the past 90 days?”
“How much annual dividend and deposit interest income am I projected to receive, and what share of my FIRE spending does it cover?”
“Preview adding 10 shares of AAPL at $225 executed today, and wait for my approval before recording it.”
security_items_html: Localhost-only binding: Listens on 127.0.0.1 only—not exposed to your LAN or the internet.
App lock respected: Requests are blocked when WorthTrail is locked.
Prompt-injection hygiene: Tool instructions explicitly tell agents to treat user-entered names, symbols, tags, and notes strictly as data, never as instructions.
Instant revocation: Turn off the switch, change the port, or reset the Keychain token at any time to disconnect all clients immediately.

help_groups.title: Market Data, Quotes & Custom Assets
items_html: Check quote connectivity under Settings > Data Sources & Status. The status test calls the exact same endpoint as live refreshes.

For unlisted holdings, real estate, gold, or private funds, add a Custom Asset and update its valuation whenever you wish.

Use Batch Import to import multiple holdings from CSV files or broker screenshots (OCR runs entirely on-device).

Historical snapshots populate your Net Worth curve and P&L Calendar and are included in both iCloud sync and encrypted local backups.

help_groups.title: iCloud Sync, Encrypted Backups & Pro Restore
items_html: Optional multi-device sync runs through your personal Apple iCloud (CloudKit) private database—ensure iCloud Drive/Sync is signed in with the same Apple Account on all devices.
You can export and restore password-encrypted local backup files anytime in Settings.
To restore a Pro subscription or Lifetime purchase on a new device, open the Pro screen in Settings and tap Restore Purchases.
WorthTrail has no user account: deleting the app removes local data, and iCloud data can be managed directly in Apple iCloud settings.

help_groups.title: Privacy Lock, Widgets & Mac MCP
items_html: Tap the eye icon next to Net Worth to hide monetary amounts on screen.
Add WorthTrail from the iOS Home Screen widget gallery; the privacy widget shows only percentage change and a trend line.

For Mac MCP connection issues, confirm WorthTrail is open on Mac, Settings > Agent Access is enabled, the app is unlocked, and your client uses http://127.0.0.1:47821/mcp with your current Keychain Bearer token.

sections.title: Data Stored on Your Device
paragraphs_html: WorthTrail stores your assets, quantities, cost basis, liabilities, position-adjustment records, dividends, recurring plans, tags, notes, settings, and historical snapshots locally on your device using Apple SwiftData.
The developer does not operate any backend server that receives, stores, or inspects your portfolio data, and WorthTrail does not require creating a user account.

sections.title: Optional Private iCloud Sync
paragraphs_html: If you enable iCloud sync, your portfolio data syncs exclusively through your personal Apple CloudKit private database associated with your Apple Account.
The developer has no access to your private CloudKit database. Synced data is governed by Apple’s iCloud security and privacy architecture.

sections.title: Market Data & Exchange Rate Providers
paragraphs_html: When you search for an asset or refresh prices and exchange rates, WorthTrail sends only the necessary search term, symbol, provider identifier, and requested currency to the market-data providers you have enabled under Settings > Data Sources & Status.

These providers—which may include Yahoo Finance, Webull, Sina Finance, Binance, OKX, CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap, TWSE, ExchangeRate-API, and supported bank wealth product feeds—may receive your IP address and standard network metadata and process them under their own privacy policies. WorthTrail never sends your portfolio quantities, cost basis, or account balances to any market-data provider.

sections.title: On-Device OCR, Widgets, Backups & Diagnostics
paragraphs_html: Screenshot Batch Import (OCR): Images you select for batch import are recognized locally on your device using Apple’s on-device Vision framework and are not uploaded to WorthTrail servers.
Widgets: WorthTrail Home Screen widgets read only the summary data required for display through the app’s private App Group container. The Privacy Widget omits all monetary amounts.

Local Backups & Diagnostics: Password-protected local backups are encrypted on your device before export. Optional .wtdiag diagnostic files are generated only when you initiate an export to help troubleshoot an issue and are encrypted before leaving the app.

sections.title: Mac Local MCP Server
paragraphs_html: WorthTrail for Mac includes an optional local Streamable HTTP MCP server bound strictly to 127.0.0.1 (localhost) and authenticated with a Bearer token stored in your macOS Keychain. It is disabled by default, read-only unless you separately enable write access, and requires a two-step preview and confirmation code for every write.

If you connect WorthTrail’s local MCP server to an AI client (such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop, or Codex), any portfolio data you instruct that AI client to query will be handled according to that AI client’s and model provider’s own privacy policy.

sections.title: No Ads, No Tracking, Purchases & App Lock
paragraphs_html: WorthTrail contains no advertising, no cross-app tracking, and no third-party analytics SDKs.

In-app purchases and subscriptions are processed exclusively by Apple StoreKit. Face ID and Touch ID are handled by iOS/macOS, and biometric data is never accessible to WorthTrail. Passcode lock stores only a salted cryptographic hash on your device.

sections.title: Deleting Your Data, Policy Updates & Contact
paragraphs_html: You can remove all local data at any time by deleting WorthTrail from your device. You can manage or remove iCloud-synced data through your device’s Apple iCloud settings, and delete any exported backup, Excel, PDF, or diagnostic files wherever you saved them.
This privacy policy may be updated when app capabilities change. If you have any privacy questions, please reach out via the Support page or email support@worthtrail.app.
